title: Cosine similarity
prompt:
Implement `cosine_similarity(a, b)` in solution.py.

Return the cosine similarity of two equal-length float lists.
If either vector has ~0 norm, return 0.0. Stdlib math.
test_source:
import math
import solution

def run():
    assert abs(solution.cosine_similarity([1,2,3],[1,2,3])-1.0)<1e-12
    assert abs(solution.cosine_similarity([1,0],[0,1]))<1e-12
    assert solution.cosine_similarity([0,0],[1,2])==0.0
    v=solution.cosine_similarity([1,1],[1,0])
    assert abs(v-math.sqrt(2)/2)<1e-12
